description: Explore why desire may have changed and get one personalized, consent-based intimacy exercise. Use for questions about low desire, feeling disconnected, or not knowing what changed. Non-explicit, 18+ only, and not medical advice.

comfort.description: How much directness the user wants. Bold still means non-explicit.

factors.description: Optional factors the user already recognizes. Omit to let Coral infer from the situation.

partnered.description: Whether the user is currently in a relationship.

situation.description: A short summary of the user situation in their own words, for example "I want sex less than my partner and I feel guilty".

name: coral_desire_checkin
title: Coral desire check-in
